jobs.title: Sr Principal Software Engineer (26-355)
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Sr Principal Software Development Analyst – SW Engr (26-355)
to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels.

This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options.

Position Overview

This role is for a Software Engineer working on the C2BMC program, supporting one of the Regional Applications teams in Colorado Springs—either User Interface, Enterprise Services, or RA-An. The candidate will work with minimal supervision, offering specialized expertise across various software disciplines and a broad understanding of related systems and customer environments. Responsibilities involve detailed analysis and technical support for systems software products, including troubleshooting complex issues, designing, developing, integrating, conducting formal testing, deploying in operations, and providing user support.

Essential Functions

Responsible for in-depth analysis and technical support for systems software products, including complex problem resolution, design, development, testing, operational integration, and user support
Handles currency updates, debugs, and configures associated software products
Works from specifications to develop or modify operating system applications
Assists with design, coding, benchmark testing, debugging, and documentation of programs
Interfaces with other system support groups to resolve problems, set standards, and improve the operating system's overall efficiency
Designs, codes, tests, and implements tools for operational automation
Works on most phases of software systems programming applications and may require minor instruction and guidance in other phases
Leadership positions on small, software-focused teams may be required

Basic Qualifications

Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable.

A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 8 years of experience; or a Master’s degree in a related field with 6 years of relevant work experience; or 12 years of relevant work experience may be considered as an alternative to a degree
Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
Experience in at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, C#, C++, Python, etc.)
Experience with software integration and formal testing
Strong understanding of software development best practices and the ability to apply them in a multi-team environment
Excellent problem-solving skills with a proven track record of root-cause analysis and issue resolution
Proven ability to mentor and motivate junior engineers, fostering a collaborative environment that promotes continuous learning and drives the team toward shared success
Candidate must have excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team environment
Software engineering and software development with strong Java/J2EE experience
The candidate will have experience and knowledge of software practices such as coding standards, automated testing, automated build pipelines, and configuration management
Experience developing enterprise applications on Linux (Windows experience also desired)
Extensive Experience with Java foundation classes and toolkits
Possess strong problem-solving skills, capable of analyzing performance and operational issues, pinpointing root causes, and proposing, designing, and implementing effective solutions
Use of common software development and management tools such as Maven, Git/GitHub, Nexus, and Eclipse
Experience in Agile development methodologies
Understanding of standard system engineering design artifacts such as Use Cases and SysML diagrams

Preferred Qualifications

Small team leadership experience (Agile team leadership strongly desired); mentoring and guiding junior engineers
Knowledge of server side/database development, computer system administration; Net-centric, horizontal integration program expertise is a plus

What We Can Offer You

Northrop Grumman offers a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment that fosters your growth, benefiting both employees and the company. The benefits are flexible and customizable, allowing you to choose options that meet your individual and family needs. Your benefits will include the following:

Health Plan
Savings Plan
Paid Time Off
Education Assistance
Training and Development
Flexible Work Arrangements

https://benefits.northropgrumman.com/us/en2/BenefitsOverview/Pages/default.aspx

Primary Level Salary Range: $129,300.00 - $193,900.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Sr Principal Systems Engineer – Verification Product Owner (26-384)
to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels.

This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options.

Position Overview

In this role, the selected candidate will be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from development through testing and into deployment and operations. The Verification Test Lead will execute test tasks in accordance with program processes, support resource planning, assist the Engineering Review Boards as appropriate, and support Task Order and customer reviews, as well as metrics collection and analysis. This position requires daily technical and programmatic interaction with civilian, military, and contract leadership, as well as with technical personnel at MDIOC and Highway 83 LM Offices. The role also includes joining the Engineering Support ART and working closely with the Program Leadership for the C2BMC National Team and the MDA BC Customer. The role is responsible for creating a cohesive test strategy across the C2BMC Task Orders and Capabilities. This includes working with their team to monitor a delivery from release creation through TIL testing, developing the C2BMC Test Plan for the capability, and elevating challenges or findings through the appropriate channels.

Essential Functions

Responsible for coordinating with key partners in milestone design meetings, reviewing and assisting in resolving technical test issues, managing Verification and Test Risks, reporting Program Metrics and Verification Status, and coordinating with technical leads and product owners to ensure successful completion of the necessary testing and verification
Engaging the C2BMC (Command & Control, Battle Management, and Communications) system to provide technical support to Agile Product Teams and the I&T functional area for hardware, software, and system-level verification and validation testing
Defining the Overarching Test Strategy for Capabilities across the Program- Defining Risk Mitigation and providing Status of Risks
Presenting Verification Plan at Program Milestone Reviews
Presenting the Verification Status and Metrics to C2BMC and BC Leadership- Representing C2BMC NT in Test Working Groups to help define testing of capabilities across the C2BMC Program
Presenting C2BMC Program with Verification requirements for Iteration Planning
Responsible for verification inputs into proposal and Engineering Estimate activities
Scheduling lab test and installation activities, coordinating with BMDSS (Ballistic Missile Defense Support Systems), Test Bed Contractor, Test Bed Lab Manager, and MDA BCX and the C2BMC NT Integration Team on spiral release installation and integration schedules in the test labs
Reviewing and providing technical feedback to Detailed Test and Analysis Procedures

Basic Qualifications

Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable.

A Bachelor’s Degree in STEM Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 8 years of experience; or a Master’s degree (preferred) in a STEM-related field with 6 years of relevant work experience; or a PhD in a related discipline with 4 years of relevant work experience
Applicants must have a current, active Government-Issued 8140 certification at IAT Level II or higher (such as Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, CySA+, CND, etc.) at the time of application, which is required to start. The candidate is responsible for maintaining their 8140 certifications throughout the entire contract period
Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
Knowledge of the integration and testing of Command & Control systems with applied relevance to the basic architecture used in the BMDS environment and focused on C2BMC, including external C2BMC element interfaces
Daily use of computers running Windows, MS Office, or Linux is required.
Demonstrated knowledge of and experience with hardware and software verification and validation processes and techniques, test reporting, regression testing, and test data analysis
Capable of managing multiple projects across teams
Capable of assisting test engineers with troubleshooting and analyzing test-bed configurations related to hardware, software, stimuli, and Information Assurance issues or functionality
Ability to synthesize input from multiple personnel into a technical report for the customer, present information in a public forum, and field relevant questions

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Systems Engineering is highly preferred
Certification: INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) Certification
Certification: Object Management Group Certified Systems Modeling Professional - Model Builder Fundamental (OCSMP - MBF)
Prior C2BMC experience is highly desired
Experience in Agile Test-Driven Development
Knowledge of the integration and testing of Command & Control systems with applied relevance to basic architecture used in the BMDS environment and focused on C2BMC, including external C2BMC element interfaces
Experience with Risk and Opportunity Management
Experience with DOORS, JIRA, and Confluence
Experience with test automation tools such as Gherkin and Cucumber
Knowledge of basic message formats such as TADIL-J, HTML, and ATOMSK
Technical understanding of computer network systems, servers, VMs, and multicast techniques, including hardware such as firewalls, routers, switches, and blade servers.

What We Can Offer You

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment that encourages your growth, benefiting both employees and the company. The benefits are flexible and customizable, enabling you to choose options that suit your individual and family needs. Your benefits will include the following:

Health Plan
Savings Plan
Paid Time Off
Education Assistance
Training and Development
Flexible Work Arrangements
